dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 29, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Braves Blast Past Reds in 8-3 Thriller**

A dominant performance by the Atlanta Braves' staff led to an 8-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds. Ronald Acuña Jr. and Michael Harris II led the charge, with Acuña Jr. notching a key hit and Harris II driving in multiple runs. On the mound, Dylan Lee threw a scoreless inning, striking out three to solidify the win.

**Padres Edge Nationals in 7-5 Nail-Biter**

The San Diego Padres took down the Washington Nationals 7-5, behind a strong performance from their staff. Curtis Mead hit a two-run homer and Jackson Merrill added a solo shot, helping the Padres secure the win. Jeremiah Estrada earned the save, closing out the game in the ninth.

**Pirates Pull Off Stunning Comeback Against Twins**

In a thrilling matchup, the Pittsburgh Pirates came from behind to defeat the Minnesota Twins 6-5. Trevor Larnach hit a two-run homer, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Pirates' late surge. Bryan Reynolds added a solo homer for the Pirates, who secured their first win of the season.

**Blue Jays Edge Orioles in 6-5 Thriller**

The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Baltimore Orioles 6-5, thanks to a strong performance from their staff. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. doubled in two runs, and Samuel Basallo added a two-run homer to help the Blue Jays secure the win. Braydon Fisher earned the save, closing out the game in the ninth.

**Guardians Outlast Red Sox in 4-3 Thriller**

The Cleveland Guardians edged the Boston Red Sox 4-3, thanks to a dominant performance from their staff. Marcelo Mayer drove in a run on a single, and Brayan Bello threw seven scoreless innings to keep the Red Sox at bay. Colin Holderman earned the save, closing out the game in the ninth.

**Rays Outlast Angels in 8-5 Thriller**

The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Los Angeles Angels 8-5, behind a strong performance from their staff. Yandy Díaz hit two home runs, driving in three runs to help the Rays secure the win. Nick Martinez earned the win, throwing six strong innings.

**Mets Edge Marlins in 9-7 Thriller**

The New York Mets edged the Miami Marlins 9-7, thanks to a strong performance from their staff. MJ Melendez hit a three-run homer, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Mets' late surge. Austin Warren earned the win, throwing two scoreless innings to seal the deal.

**Cardinals Outlast Cubs in 6-5 Thriller**

The St. Louis Cardinals edged the Chicago Cubs 6-5, thanks to a strong performance from their staff. Ian Happ hit a three-run homer, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Cardinals' late surge. Riley O'Brien earned the save, closing out the game in the ninth.

**White Sox Edge Tigers in 4-3 Thriller**

The Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers 4-3, thanks to a strong performance from their staff. Miguel Vargas hit a three-run homer, driving in the winning run for the White Sox. Bryan Hudson earned the win, throwing two scoreless innings to seal the deal.

**Rangers Rout Royals in 9-1 Thriller**

The Texas Rangers dominated the Kansas City Royals 9-1, behind a strong performance from their staff. Nicky Lopez hit a two-run homer, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Rangers' dominance. MacKenzie Gore earned the win, throwing six scoreless innings.

**Brewers Edge Astros in 5-4 Thriller**

The Milwaukee Brewers took down the Houston Astros 5-4, thanks to a strong performance from their staff. Cam Smith hit a two-run homer, driving in the winning run for the Brewers. Trevor Megill earned the save, closing out the game in the ninth.

**Rockies Outlast Giants in 8-6 Thriller**

The Colorado Rockies edged the San Francisco Giants 8-6, thanks to a strong performance from their staff. Ezequiel Tovar hit two home runs, driving in four runs to help the Rockies secure the win. Juan Mejia earned the win, throwing two scoreless innings to seal the deal.

**Yankees Rout Athletics in 8-2 Thriller**

The New York Yankees dominated the Athletics 8-2, behind a strong performance from their staff. Ben Rice hit a three-run homer, driving in multiple runs for the Yankees. Carlos Rodón earned the win, throwing two scoreless innings to seal the deal.

**Mariners Outlast Diamondbacks in 7-6 Thriller**

The Seattle Mariners took down the Arizona Diamondbacks 7-6, thanks to a strong performance from their staff. J.P. Crawford hit two home runs, driving in three runs to help the Mariners secure the win. Cooper Criswell earned the win, throwing two scoreless innings to seal the deal.

**Dodgers Outlast Phillies in 4-2 Thriller**

The Los Angeles Dodgers edged the Philadelphia Phillies 4-2, thanks to a strong performance from their staff. Shohei Ohtani hit a solo homer, driving in a run for the Dodgers. Justin Wrobleski earned the win, throwing seven scoreless innings to seal the deal.
